purpose: Linkage-section DB PCB mask for the pending authorization database (DBPAUTP0, segments PAUTSUM0/PAUTDTL1). PAUDBUNL, PAUDBLOD and DBUNLDGS receive it through ENTRY 'DLITCBL' / PROCEDURE DIVISION USING and pass it to CBLTDLI calls; programs test PAUT-PCB-STATUS after each call and display PAUT-KEYFB on failure.

key_fields.name: PAUT-PCB-STATUS
key_fields.meaning: DL/I status code after each call (spaces OK, GB end of DB, GE not found, II duplicate).

key_fields.name: PAUT-SEG-NAME
key_fields.meaning: Name of the last segment accessed.

key_fields.name: PAUT-KEYFB
key_fields.meaning: Key feedback area (255 bytes) displayed in error diagnostics.
